config.selection: minimum fixed validation-pair softplus loss; same selector for every objective; tie earliest epoch
config.pair_contract: same user and fixed 30-minute exposure-time bin, distinct items; exclude within-bin contradictory-label items, collapse repeated consistent items to earliest event, one uniform observed nonclick per clicked item with replacement; only original fixed 1m training rows
config.scope: pseudo-contexts, not recovered requests or slates; unclicked is observed click=0, not intrinsic dislike; feedback arrival unknown; validation development only, never test labels

followup.pair_sampling: independent-generator uniform draws with replacement, one pair per full exposure row per epoch
followup.selection: same fixed validation pair loss as initial protocol
followup.reason: exposure AUC dropped under balanced pair-endpoint BCE; test full-exposure BCE plus pair loss without removing original samples

protocol.repair: B paired_bce/pairwise/mixed coverage now counts actual repeated pair endpoints, not full exposure sample
